summary.title: ING BIRGER ÅDLANDSVIK AS

narrative.text: ING BIRGER ÅDLANDSVIK AS is a Norwegian private limited company in "Elektrisk installasjonsarbeid", registered 2000-11-25.
Registered activity: Elektroentreprenør med tilhørenede varehandel.
Latest filed legal-entity accounts for 2025 show revenue of NOK 579,139 and an annual result of NOK -112,100.
Registered leadership: Ronny Ådlandsvik (Daglig leder); Ronny Ådlandsvik (Styrets leder).
Head office in Herdla, with 1 registered workplace.
Not established from permitted exact-entity sources: brand, group, website, company profiles, jobs, public activity. This is not proof of absence.
